description: R4-a derive-or-refute: can any corpus combinatorial object produce the A^(-1/3) packing-energy exponent of E_pair = (3/5)·alpha·m_pi·A^(-1/3)? Symbolic prune (formalize-first): (a) equipartition over the Lean-proved chain counts gives integer exponents 1/2/3 only; (b) the Milnor/LCS Witt tower has harmonic (1/n) and factorial normalizations, no cube root; (c) [A]_q is exponential at q0 and reduces to A only at q=1 — all three REFUTED as producers of -1/3. Numerical shape test on the 8 T_z mirror pairs: p = 1/3 scatter 0.077 coeff 0.983; measured effective exponent p* = 0.252 ± 0.020 (1/3 at 4.1 sigma, 1/4 at 0.1 sigma — OLS-internal, correlated systematics not included); the coefficient-1 pion-Compton property holds only at p = 1/3. VERDICT: null hypothesis (d) stands — the exponent is an empirical import (nuclear saturation-radius law), now precisely located. Scope-(a); exploratory; nothing wired.
